## Summary

Describe the reusable enablement improvement and the intended outcome.

## Validation

List the checks performed and the evidence reviewed.

## Boundary review

- [ ] Content is customer-neutral and contains no identifying information.
- [ ] Examples use only synthetic or explicitly approved sanitized data.
- [ ] No credentials, regulated data, production data, or proprietary artifacts are included.
- [ ] No unverified FedRAMP or integration authorization claim is included.
- [ ] No step performs a destructive operation or production change.
- [ ] External services and integrations are clearly marked as requiring separate approval.
- [ ] The complete diff has been reviewed.
